scientific_integrity: The complete all-parameter proof and independent direct graph enumeration are provided. Priority for the original edge-open-packing definition and the general induced-star fact belongs to cited literature.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to Cartesian rook graphs with both complete factors of order at least two; finite computational checks corroborate but cannot replace the all-parameter proof; undiscovered equivalent literature is possible.
title: Complete edge-open-packing polynomial and odd-square rigidity of rook graphs
